steps.t: Work out what I actually need
See what is new and popular
Check it fits what I own
Send it to the brand for repair

needs.t: I want one good pan that does eggs in the morning and a stir-fry at night.
needs.reason: Step 4 points to the right product type but leaves the specific pan and dual-use question open.
needs.evidence: Step 4 points to the right product type but leaves the specific pan and dual-use question open.

needs.t: Do the handles get hot after twenty minutes on the hob?
needs.reason: Step 1 covers materials and heat limits, not whether handles become hot during normal hob use.
needs.evidence: Step 1 covers materials and heat limits, not whether handles become hot during normal hob use.

needs.t: Is the hand-hammered copper range worth three times the price of the stainless one, or is it just for show?
needs.reason: Step 1 compares features and price but does not state whether the copper is worth the premium or just cosmetic
needs.evidence: Step 1 compares features and price but does not state whether the copper is worth the premium or just cosmetic

needs.t: I'm blind. Can I use this coffee machine without reading the display?
needs.reason: General instructions or a video do not say if the machine works without reading the display.
needs.evidence: General instructions or a video do not say if the machine works without reading the display.

needs.t: I have arthritis. I need a kettle I can fill, lift and pour without much grip.
needs.reason: General care, repair and compatibility steps say nothing about filling, lifting or pouring with limited grip.
needs.evidence: Steps 1–5 address maintenance, cleaning, compatibility, repair and troubleshooting only; none mention arthritis, grip, lifting or pouring.

needs.t: What's the real difference between the two espresso machines apart from the steam wand?
needs.reason: Step 1 explicitly compares features and price and lists model differences as a question it answers.
needs.evidence: Step 1 explicitly compares features and price and lists model differences as a question it answers

needs.t: Will the blender crush ice for smoothies, or only soft fruit?
needs.reason: No step covers blending performance or ice-crushing ability; they only cover compatibility, faults, comparison, variants, and materials.
needs.evidence: none

needs.t: Is the toaster wide enough for sourdough slices?
needs.reason: Step 3 gives overall dimensions and weight, not the slot width needed for sourdough.
needs.evidence: Step 3 gives overall dimensions and weight, not the slot width needed for sourdough.

needs.t: Which food processor is easy to clean for someone who hates washing up?
needs.reason: Step 1 tells how to clean after purchase, not which model is easiest to choose.
needs.evidence: none

needs.t: Will the stand mixer fit under my wall cupboards? I have 45 centimetres of clearance.
needs.reason: Step 1 explicitly covers whether it fits the space and gives size and dimensions.
needs.evidence: Step 1 explicitly covers whether it fits the space and gives size and dimensions.

needs.t: I need a toaster that is easy to see and use with low vision: big buttons, high contrast.
needs.reason: No step mentions button size, contrast, or low-vision usability; they cover only general features and specs.
needs.evidence: No step mentions button size, contrast, or low-vision usability; they cover only general features and specs.

needs.t: Are the replacement filters still sold for last year's kettle?
needs.reason: Step 1 mentions filters but does not confirm they are still sold for last year's kettle.
needs.evidence: Step 1 mentions filters but does not confirm they are still sold for last year's kettle

needs.t: I need a wedding present from their list, under a hundred pounds, that will still be in their kitchen in ten years.
needs.reason: Step 1 covers gift and budget, but not the wedding list or ten-year durability.
needs.evidence: Step 1 covers gift and budget, but not the wedding list or ten-year durability.

needs.t: My dad has just retired and wants to learn to cook. Where do I even start?
needs.reason: Step 3 explicitly covers working out what you need before looking and lists “Where do I start?” as a question it answers.
needs.evidence: Step 3 explicitly covers working out what you need before looking and lists “Where do I start?” as a question it answers.

needs.t: What's new this season? Nothing in mind, just looking.
needs.reason: Step 1 explicitly shows new arrivals, which is exactly what a seasonal browser needs.
needs.evidence: Step 1 explicitly shows new arrivals, which is exactly what a seasonal browser needs.

needs.t: Is there a bundle that works out cheaper than the machine and grinder separately?
needs.reason: Step 1 explicitly includes checking bundle offers and prices, which directly answers the bundle question.
needs.evidence: Step 1 explicitly includes checking bundle offers and prices, which directly answers the bundle question.

needs.t: Will it arrive before Saturday if I order today?
needs.reason: Step 1 explicitly covers checking how quickly it will arrive before committing.
needs.evidence: Step 1 explicitly covers checking how quickly it will arrive before committing.

needs.t: Can I return a gift if they already have one, without them seeing the price?
needs.reason: No step explains returning a duplicate gift or keeping the price hidden from the recipient.
needs.evidence: Step 1 covers sending an item back for money, not returning a gift or hiding its price.

needs.t: Can I talk to someone who knows the products? I don't know what I need.
needs.reason: Step 3 provides shop contact but not explicit product expertise or needs-based advice.
needs.evidence: Step 3 provides shop contact but not explicit product expertise or needs-based advice

needs.t: The green colour is out of stock in this size. Will it come back?
needs.reason: Step 1 shows current stock only, not whether the green colour will be restocked in that size.
needs.evidence: Step 1 shows current stock only, not whether the green colour will be restocked in that size.

needs.t: I want to send it straight to the couple with a gift note and no price inside.
needs.reason: Step 3 covers where to deliver it, but not the gift note or hiding the price.
needs.evidence: Step 3 covers where to deliver it, but not the gift note or hiding the price.

needs.t: My discount code says it's invalid but the email says it runs until Sunday.
needs.reason: Step 1 explicitly answers why a discount code fails and how to apply it.
needs.evidence: Step 1 explicitly lists “Why does my code not work?” as a question it answers.

needs.t: Can I pay for the espresso machine in instalments without a credit check?
needs.reason: None of the steps cover payment options, instalments, or credit checks.
needs.evidence: none

needs.t: Can I change the pan size after I've placed the order?
needs.reason: Step 1 offers size swaps but does not confirm changes to an order already placed.
needs.evidence: Step 1 offers size swaps but does not confirm changes to an order already placed.

needs.t: The error message says something is wrong but not which field.
needs.reason: No step identifies the specific field; they only cover repair, contact, or general faults.
needs.evidence: Step 5 explains general wear or faults, while step 2 only offers contact; neither names the specific field.

needs.t: How do I set up the grinder? The instructions are only pictures.
needs.reason: Step 2 explicitly covers unboxing and first-time setup, which directly answers the customer's question.
needs.evidence: Step 2 explicitly covers unboxing and first-time setup, which directly answers the customer's question.

needs.t: My cast-iron pan has gone rusty after the dishwasher. Can I save it?
needs.reason: Step 5 explicitly covers DIY repair of damage and buying the right products, which directly answers saving the pan.
needs.evidence: Step 5 explicitly covers DIY repair of damage and buying the right products, which directly answers saving the pan.

needs.t: My espresso tastes sour. Is it the beans, the grind or the machine?

needs.evidence: No step explains how to diagnose sour espresso by bean, grind or machine

needs.t: The enamel on the casserole has chipped. Is it still safe to cook in?
needs.reason: Step 1 covers general materials and heat limits, not whether a chipped enamel surface is safe for cooking.
needs.evidence: Step 1 covers general materials and heat limits, not whether a chipped enamel surface is safe for cooking.

needs.t: My grandmother left me her copper pans. Can they be re-tinned, and what would it cost?
needs.reason: The repair step includes a quote, which directly answers whether re-tinning can be done and its price.
needs.evidence: Step 1 offers a brand repair service with a quote and timescale, directly addressing whether the pans can be repaired and the price.

needs.t: Time to reorder the water filters. Same ones as last time.
needs.reason: Step 1 explicitly lets the customer buy the same thing again quickly, which is exactly what they need.
needs.evidence: Step 1 explicitly lets the customer buy the same thing again quickly, which is exactly what they need.

needs.t: I lost the receipt. Is the guarantee still valid?
needs.reason: No step explicitly confirms that the guarantee remains valid without a receipt or lists acceptable alternatives.
needs.evidence: No step explicitly confirms that the guarantee remains valid without a receipt or lists acceptable alternatives.

needs.t: How do I dispose of an old toaster safely? Can it go in the bin?
needs.reason: Step 1 directly covers safe disposal and recycling at end of life, which is exactly what the customer asks.
needs.evidence: Step 1 is explicitly about getting rid of the item safely or recycling it at end of life.

needs.t: I'm selling my copper set second-hand. How do I prove it's genuine?
needs.reason: No step explicitly offers proof of authenticity, so the customer would still be asking how to prove it.
needs.evidence: Step 5 offers restoration or valuation of old items, but its explicit questions are about restoration cost and value, not proof of authenticity.

needs.t: The return label needs a printer and I don't have one.
needs.reason: Return instructions explain how to send it back but not how to get a label without a printer.
needs.evidence: Step 1 covers the refund return process but never mentions label alternatives for customers without a printer.

needs.t: My son wants to learn proper latte art. Is there a beginner's guide?
needs.reason: Step 1 explicitly covers instructions or a video and says it answers whether a guide exists.
needs.evidence: Step 1 explicitly covers instructions or a video and says it answers whether a guide exists.

needs.t: How often should I season the cast-iron pan, and with what oil?
needs.reason: Step 1 mentions seasoning but does not specify frequency or oil type.
needs.evidence: Step 1 mentions seasoning but does not specify frequency or oil type.

needs.t: The food processor has started smelling of burning. Is it safe to use?
needs.reason: Fault diagnosis and material checks do not say whether a burning smell makes the processor unsafe to use
needs.evidence: Fault diagnosis and material checks do not say whether a burning smell makes the processor unsafe to use

needs.t: The product photos have no descriptions, so my screen reader just says 'image'. What does the kettle look like?
needs.reason: No step offers alt text or a written description of the kettle's appearance
needs.evidence: No step offers alt text or a written description of the kettle's appearance

needs.t: The delivery driver only rings once and I can't get to the door quickly. Can they wait or leave it with a neighbour?
needs.reason: The steps cover delivery logistics and address entry but never state whether drivers can wait or leave parcels with neighbours.
needs.evidence: The steps cover delivery logistics and address entry but never state whether drivers can wait or leave parcels with neighbours.
